notes.title: You Won’t Believe This Gameplay!
notes.content:
This is survival redefined – this is No More Light.

What if the nightmare chasing you could be bent to your will?

In No More Light, you’ll not only face grotesque creatures – you’ll control them. Wander through haunting environments, uncover secrets hidden in the shadows, and decide how far you’re willing to go as your humanity slips away.


[previewyoutube="YasCPz4zmhY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ⚡ New gameplay from the world of No More Light!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38698906/0c38609dc0c351479992d5c46eb566a42aec26de.png"]
In our latest Gameplay video, your character navigates biomass-covered and open-field areas while using their parasite abilities. Fight massive enemies, avoid the attacks of stalkers, and discover hidden mechanics that help you survive in this grotesque, dark world. Every moment of the game tests your strategic thinking and reflexes.Every decision and every move counts: the world is dark, unpredictable, and a fight can turn in an instant. This video gives a glimpse into the intense, strategic, and post-apocalyptic experience of No More Light.

[previewyoutube="VW4YNu2FVDs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Master the Storm – Control the Chaos in No More Light
notes.content:
In the world of No More Light, the sky rages while the aliens’ HAARP stations distort reality. 
But those who are brave enough can seize this power!
 Manipulate the elements, destroy biomass clusters, and turn the insectoid swarms against each other.
Solve a variety of challenges using the raw force of nature.

Soon, you'll see more of the world of No More Light.
[previewyoutube="xBZlvTUESoc;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Thank you for helping us reach over 10,000 wishlists on Steam!
notes.content:
Thank you for helping us reach over 10,000 wishlists on Steam!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38698906/0c38609dc0c351479992d5c46eb566a42aec26de.png"]
This is a huge milestone for us — and your support means the world.
Behind the scenes, we’re working hard to bring a unique, unsettling world to life — where survival isn't just about fighting… it's about control.


With our Parasite Control system, you won’t just face the alien threats — you'll command them.
Take control of insectoid creatures, solve tasks in creative ways, and reshape the world to serve your goals.

All of this takes place in a world where the light has vanished… and what remains is no longer human.

Your body is still human... but not for much longer.
More videos and reveals are coming soon — giving you deeper glimpses into what’s taking shape. 
[previewyoutube="v99PZiioJk4;full"][/previewyoutube]
